messages:
Maya: Heads-up — we need to lock press/analyst briefings for next-week launch. Need embargo wording, quote sign-offs, and a fact-check window for EU/APAC reporters. Who can own slots and the quote localization? :calendar:

Sam: I can drive scheduling. Suggest three 30-min windows: Tue 9am PT / Tue 5pm GMT / Wed 8am SGT. Also want to route inbound analyst requests to a single queue (marketing@redwood.com). Will create a single intake form.

Anya: I can own the queue. Ops checklist: - collect reporter timezone - confirm embargo window - provide one-pager + benchmark slide - collect quote localization (if any). Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/example-media-briefings

Leo: Product will supply 3 approved talking points + benchmark numbers by EOD today. We'll include a short methodology note. For region-specific spokes: EMEA -> Priya; APAC -> Kenji.

Tom (Legal): Quick items — need final embargo text and confirm no new NDAs required. Draft embargo: "Please treat the attached materials as embargoed until 11:00 PT on 2026-04-03." I can sign off by 4pm today. CC compliance@redwood.com.

EmbargoBot: Automatic reminder — embargo window registered: 2026-04-03 11:00 PT. Reaction suggested: :warning:.

Sam: Good. I'll spin up the schedule page + calendar invites with 15-min buffers. Proposed owners: Maya (media leads), Anya (ops queue), Leo (product follow-up), Tom (legal sign-off). I'll tag owners in the invite.

Maya: Thanks — one more ask: can we prepare a regional phrasing matrix for quotes? US: metrics + customer anecdote; EMEA: privacy/compliance focus; APAC: latency/perf emphasis. I'll draft and post to the sheet.

Anya: For fact-checks: standard data -> 24 hours; benchmarks -> 48 hours. Suggest requiring a short embargo confirmation checkbox on intake form. I'll add it.

Tom (Legal): 24/48 windows OK. Please archive all fact-check correspondence to the legal drive. :heavy_check_mark:

Sam: On it — creating invites now and will share final one-pager + quote options by 18:00 PT.

Maya: :thumbsup: Thanks team. If any reporter asks to lift embargo earlier, tag me + Tom and don't confirm on thread.
